content.rendered:
Sometime in the autumn of 1979, at his home in Holmdel, Bruce recorded this little ditty:

What’s it about?

I don’t know!

Sorry, I couldn’t resist. But seriously, I’m not even sure that Bruce knew what it was about. “I Don’t Know” sounds more a melody in search of lyrics. What few lines are intelligible are almost certainly bluffed. Bruce does this often when working on a song–he warps (and sometimes warps) a melody around a turn of phrase that he particularly likes. Sometimes it reflects the heart of the song, other times its just a hook, and I suspect in this case it’s the latter.

“I Don’t Know” doesn’t appear to have evolved into any finished, released Springsteen song–none to which I can trace a genealogical link, anyway.

Might there be a finished version of the song somewhere in the vault?

Perhaps, but baby…

I Don’t Know
Recorded: Autumn 1979 (early demo only)
Never performed

® October 30, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Bruce recorded a home demo of “I Don’t Know” in 1979. What’s it about? Like the song says…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Mary Lou
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Meet "Mary Lou," big sister to "Be True." They share the same lyrics, yet they're completely different songs. Let's trace their origins together and hear how Bruce constructs a song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: All I Need
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One of the best full-band outtakes from the Nebraska era, the E Street Band's recording of "All I Need" made for a fine deep cut for Gary U.S. Bonds.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Bring on the Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Bring on the Night" is one of the weaker outtakes on Tracks, but it offers insight into its descendant, "My Love Will Not Let You Down."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Mr. Outside
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The curious case of a bootleg turned official release (and the mystery of why bother).

jetpack-related-posts.title: Take ‘Em as They Come
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A classic Springsteen formula--dark lyrics paired with a power pop melody--results in a shoulda-been new wave classic. Insights and great performances inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Walking in the Street
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Walking in the Street" -- a never-released, never-performed alternative path for Springsteen's "Thunder Road."
